chunks.bytesMeaning: whole asset bytes, not chunk length

refusal.message: The requested asset digest is not available.

chunks.refusalRule: Typed protocol Error, never a tool-result body; message contains no request data.

carrier.successRule: structuredContent is exactly the projected and validated result (or items/next page); no id, success, text, view or session sidecars are added.
carrier.failureRule: Keep code; replace handler message with operations.rs fixed table or generic fallback; drop data and sidecars.
carrier.sessionRefusals: session_not_bound and session_route_ambiguous are typed protocol Error frames, not carrier bodies. Gate refusals keep the gate frame.

frameKey.retry: Identical key/request replays the identical provider-frame body under the retry correlation header; not a fresh poll.
frameKey.scopedCarrier: reserved:occipital# + compact JSON [owner principal_id, scope_ref, scope_epoch as canonical decimal string]
frameKey.isolation: Never use policy-route principal or S scope for the ledger; never read or write the viewed call ledger entry or advance S custodian ack/late results.

binding.rule: Labels must exactly equal S policy route labels for every carrier call, including reads; labels do not discover S. Unscoped and self-owned scoped Occipital routes admit provider reads only.
binding.labelSource: Awaiting CKIOS confirmation of where Occipital learns S labels.
